name: Kandinsky 6 Lite INT8
summary: Aperçu 1,04 s de vidéo + son, 25 images 448×256, modèle INT8 ConvRot compact pour Cloud9. Génération à certifier avant exposition.

source.template: Kandinsky 6 Lite-distill original 12-node PiFlow T2VA full video+audio native graph, only node1 checkpoint replaced by SHA-pinned native INT8 ConvRot
source.notes: Model shadwosii/Kandinsky-6.0 pinned revision 68c1f666395f3d0bbb57cbe8093b6220ac0cb828, source LFS SHA256 523522487aeb9009a93e77f5d74bc1c817b1469aa6ce99b2b564c3da69c0f96e, 4166194712 bytes. Repackaged native Comfy int8 ConvRot quant. Official Kandinsky adapter on native CT410 already passed BF16 generation; quant needs real gfx1103 E2E. 25f 448x256 10steps, audio kept. No other source model replaced.

inputs.label: Scène vidéo
inputs.default: A natural cinematic shot of a clear mountain stream flowing over smooth rocks in daylight. Rippling water moves continuously; leaves and grasses gently sway in the breeze. A locked-off camera, realistic lighting, a single uncut shot.

inputs.label: Ambiance sonore
inputs.default: Gentle flowing water and soft wind rustling through nearby leaves, subtle distant birds.

inputs.label: Éléments à éviter
inputs.default: Static, still frame, 2D cartoon, text, blur, unnatural motion, flicker, deformed objects, low quality.

models.license: MIT (converted checkpoint repository); underlying Kandinsky original terms apply

test.prompt: A tiny orange fox trotting across a sunlit meadow of tall grass, its tail swaying as it moves, soft wind and distant chirping birds, steady cinematic camera, continuous realistic motion.
test.sound: Soft wind rustling tall grass, gentle fox paw steps and distant morning bird calls, no speech.
test.negative: Static, still frame, 2D cartoon, text, blur, unnatural motion, flicker, deformed objects, low quality.

notes: Preview 25 images/24fps, 448x256, audio and shared graph with native K6 BF16. INT8 ConvRot checkpoint is a distinct candidate, not auto-promoted; LFS SHA must pass and actual Freefield CLI output + ffprobe/visual/history required. Quality and freedom not yet qualified.
